item.title: Deep dive: Harness Engineering, Part 2: The human is the loop
item.description: Hello Iain. This is a deep dive from AI News, walking through part two of Anton Sizikov's Harness Engineering series, published on his Cloud Eng blog on November twenty-fifth. The post is called The human is the loop. As in part one, Anton works at GitHub, and he notes that the opinions are his own. Part one mapped four stages of AI-assisted work, from IDE first sessions to software factories. Par

The big story is for anyone routing open models through OpenRouter.
